## ARK beats both

|---------|-----|-----|---------------|
| Incoming | Location badge · contact | Inbox emoji · menu option · clean modal | **Vehicle · RO · estimate · last message · notes** |
| In-call grid | CRM tools | Minimal + Business tier tags | **Open RO · Text · Schedule · Pay · Note** |
| Post-call | Dispositions · tags | Activity + tasks | **Note · text · schedule · RO · handled** |
| Inbox row | Assigned to me | Shared inbox | **Vehicle · RO · turn** |
